capabilities: add color-coded markers to Markdown blocks and PDF pages
jump between markers with a marker bar and floating side controls
remember and restore the last reading position per document
search and filter markers across the current document or the whole vault
export marker-list results to a Markdown summary file
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or later; works entirely locally with no network services; PDF markers are page-level only, with no PDF text extraction or annotation.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to save and return to multiple reading positions inside a long note or PDF while reading.
summary: Adds persistent color-coded reading-position markers to Markdown notes and PDF pages, with navigation controls, progress memory, and a searchable marker list.
